evidence.quote:
Importantly, this analysis also serves as a proxy for quantitatively evaluating explanation
quality, where retrieving higher-quality case-based examples tends to yield greater performance gains.

practical_problems.note: explanations are shown in a weather case study and judged only through a prediction-performance proxy; no faithfulness or human review study

summary: Pairs a prototype encoder over series and text with prediction, reflection and refinement LLMs to improve multimodal classification of weather, finance and influenza series; it gains up to 8.9% AUC over baselines, and ablations show the text modality and refinement matter, while explanation quality is only judged by proxy.
